SeedVR2 short-video preview uses system FFmpeg shared libraries.

Observed on this development host: FFmpeg 8.0.1 (Fedora package GPLv3+), configured with --enable-gpl and libx264; x264-libs is labelled GPLv2+ by its package. Actual versions and configuration are recorded in sources.json. Included GNU license texts are copied unchanged from the installed ffmpeg-libs package.

The current developer install does not copy FFmpeg/x264 shared libraries. It requires a matching local ABI and a libx264-enabled encoder. This notice does not qualify a portable release or decide the project license; licensing and distribution of the complete application remain part of release qualification.

FFmpeg: https://ffmpeg.org
x264: https://www.videolan.org/developers/x264.html
